title: Provenance, Attribution, Rights and Payment for AI Content: A Field Guide from an MCP Point of View: updates
description: Dated events from the History section of each card, newest first.

updates.name: MCP Financial Services Interest Group
updates.text: Charter amended to problem-first scope and Working Group referrals ([#3572](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/pull/3572)). The earlier text listed "source attribution, citation, and consent metadata" and finance-specific extensions.

updates.name: SEP-2640 Skills Extension
updates.text: agentgateway merged initial support for the extension, without multiplexing ([agentgateway#4214](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway/pull/4214)).

updates.name: SEP-2640 Skills Extension
updates.text: ext-skills v0.1.0, the first tagged release, at Beta stage.

updates.name: x402
updates.text: USDC became the default stablecoin on eight more EVM networks in the TypeScript, Go and Python SDKs ([x402#4337](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/4337)).

updates.name: IETF AI Preferences Working Group
updates.text: Issues 245 and 246 on downstream survival closed.

updates.name: W3C Agentic Web Working Group (proposed)
updates.text: WebMCP replaced the `RegisteredTool` dictionary with a `Tool` interface keyed by a UUID, a breaking change ([webmcp#348](https://github.com/webmachinelearning/webmcp/pull/348)).

updates.name: x402
updates.text: AWS added AWS Billing to AgentCore payments for x402 products on AWS Marketplace ([AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/enable-ai-agents-to-pay-for-aws-marketplace-x402-products-with-amazon-bedrock-agentcore-payments/)).

updates.name: SOCAN
updates.text: Filed an amended statement of claim (Federal Court T-3803-26) that adds outputs made with Suno's v6 models, which Suno released on 2026-09-09.

updates.name: x402
updates.text: Advisory [GHSA-5cgh-j82v-jvrj](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/security/advisories/GHSA-5cgh-j82v-jvrj) (moderate): the SDKs' batch-settlement voucher verifiers accepted signatures the settlement contract cannot recover, so a receiver could hold a voucher whose claim reverts. The advisory lists no patched version. The fixes merged in [x402#4316](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/4316) and [x402#4319](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/4319).

updates.name: IETF AI Preferences Working Group
updates.text: Kevin Kelley [asked for volunteers](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/ai-control/mLGJnETEzXfUug-xJfjRnY27LvY/) for an attachment design team, at the chairs' request, to report before the next interim.

updates.name: IETF Web Bot Auth Working Group
updates.text: At IETF 127 ([session](https://datatracker.ietf.org/meeting/127/session/webbotauth), 16:30 in San Francisco, 00:30 UTC on 2026-11-18) the WG re-confirmed that tracking or reputation for sub-agents, sessions or end users is out of scope under the charter, in discussion of the Signed Agent Metadata and PACE proposals. The authors will update the httpsig-protocol draft to replace the `tag` parameter, define a minimal set of signed components and add signature-failure response headers ([minutes](https://datatracker.ietf.org/meeting/127/materials/minutes-127-webbotauth-00)).

updates.name: ai.robots.txt
updates.text: [v2.2](https://github.com/ai-robots-txt/ai.robots.txt/releases/tag/v2.2) released with the `__usage_ai-training` token.

updates.name: CC Signals
updates.text: CC [said](https://creativecommons.org/2026/11/16/advancing-cc-signals-preparing-for-public-alpha-testing-in-2027/) a public alpha is planned for early 2027 and will first focus on SourceConnection.

updates.name: Shared AI training robots.txt token
updates.text: -01 posted.

updates.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
updates.text: Nominations opened until 2026-11-27 for the [B2B Procurement](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/discussions/1094) and [Local Services](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/discussions/1093) Tech Councils.

updates.name: Internet Licensing Collective
updates.text: Launched under this name, formerly the RSL Collective, with Yahoo Scout as first commercial licensee.

updates.name: Open Knowledge Foundation
updates.text: OKFN [announced](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/shift-how-knowledge-shared-okfn-mhfof/) the launch of The Sharing Shift website and its white paper, [Envisioning Digital Public Infrastructures as Commons](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23033612).

updates.name: Really Simple Licensing
updates.text: The RSL Collective relaunched as [[internet-licensing-collective]].

updates.name: W3C Agentic Web Working Group (proposed)
updates.text: The Web Machine Learning Community Group assigned explainers for Agent Identity, Agent Delegation and Agent Interaction Measurement, due by the end of November so the charter can go to Advisory Committee review ([minutes](https://www.w3.org/2026/11/12-webmachinelearning-minutes.html)).

updates.name: AAIF Observability and Traceability WG

updates.name: AI Catalog

updates.name: Encypher

updates.name: Open Knowledge Foundation

updates.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
updates.text: Shopify [deprecated](https://shopify.dev/changelog/posts/storefront-mcp-policies-and-faqs-tool-is-being-deprecated-in-favor-of-ucp-mcp-ask-tool) its Storefront MCP `search_shop_policies_and_faqs` tool in favour of the UCP MCP `ask_business` tool, with migration due by 2027-01-15.
